items.text: PB alert — Sam took forty seconds off his last sim and Lucy owned the lunges like they owed her money.
Two new racers joined the frame this week — say hello before the start line does.
Gregor's birthday Thursday — he's banned himself from cake, we're overruled.
The Berlin trip closes Sunday — seats are shared so speak now or hold your travel.
Three of you are plotting the same race weekend — the board's there for exactly this.
And Katie — happy birthday for Tuesday. Your 7am's in the book; we'll bring the coffee and croissants on the way in.

followUp.text: The pic: us and Katie, coffee and croissants after the 7am. We keep our promises.
